segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I want coffee.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn cà phê.] [EN: Are there any rooms available?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Còn phòng không?] [EN: When I wake up, I eat breakfast.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khi tôi dậy, tôi ăn sáng.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Lúc.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: At, a moment.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Spoken questions sound friendlier with a little particle at the end. The most common, in the south, is] [VI_F: Vậy.] [EN: a falling, broken tone. It is like adding so or then. What are you doing?] [VI_F: Anh làm gì vậy?] [EN: Ask, what are you doing, casually.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh làm gì vậy?] [EN: What is wrong, or what's up, is] [VI_F: Sao vậy?] [EN: Ask it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sao vậy?] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: For a quick, right? tag, use] [VI_F: Hả?] [EN: You already heard it. You are eating, right?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ăn, hả?] [EN: And to react with oh, or really, use] [VI_F: À!] [EN: Say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: À!] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. What are you doing? casually.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh làm gì vậy?] [EN: What's up?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sao vậy?] [EN: Where are you going? casually.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh đi đâu vậy?] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Vậy?] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: A softener, like so or then.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: À!] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Oh, or really.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Anh đi đâu vậy?] [VI_M: Dạ, đi làm. Sao vậy?] [VI_F: À, không có gì.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Ask, where are you going, casually.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh đi đâu vậy?] [EN: Ask, what's up?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sao vậy?] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you talk about transport. The preview phrase is] [VI: xe buýt] [EN: which means bus.]
